findings.claim: The new explicit KBD focus project path is rendered by raw string replacement, so valid project paths containing XML/systemd-special characters produce invalid launchd plists or broken systemd environment values.
findings.evidence: Acceptance criterion requires service installation to accept an explicit KBD focus project and render both WorkingDirectory and KBD_FOCUS_PROJECT_PATH consistently for launchd and systemd; the renderer adds `"__KBD_FOCUS_PROJECT_PATH__": "KBD_FOCUS_PROJECT_PATH"` and then does `text = text.replace(k, os.environ[env])`, while the templates insert it directly into `<string>__KBD_FOCUS_PROJECT_PATH__</string>` and `Environment=KBD_FOCUS_PROJECT_PATH=__KBD_FOCUS_PROJECT_PATH__`.
findings.suggested_fix: Escape values according to the target format: XML-escape plist string values or generate the plist with a plist library, and quote/escape systemd Environment values with systemd-compatible escaping; add tests with spaces and characters such as `&` in the focus project path.
